notes.title: Samsara coming to Steam 7th Feb 2018
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31379928/05dc066cf9af45daf561b1a0a7bae42949ab4931.jpg[/img]

[b]Gorgeous puzzler [url=samsara-game.com] Samsara [/url] coming to Steam and Xbox One on February 7th[/b]


Developer Marker has announced the release date for the stunning looking Puzzler, Samsara, and it’s only a few short weeks away.

The game is coming to Xbox One, Windows 10, Steam, and the App Store for Mac. 

You play as a child called Zee, and the game contains 77 levels across 6 hand-detailed realms. 


Original article can be found here:

[url=http://www.godisageek.com/2018/01/samsara-release-date] http://www.godisageek.com/2018/01/samsara-release-date/ [/url]
